added.message: The value list gives `4` 2 times, as "deal is complete (ie. selling scomplete (ie. selling system shows deal has completed)" and as "deal is archived (cannot be active again)", so a value of `4` doesn't say which it means.
The value set 0 | 1 | 2 | 4 is a strict subset of 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4; and of 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6.
